title: Location.
officialText:
Where HPM rooms, liquid storage rooms and gas rooms are provided, they shall have at least one exterior
wall and such wall shall be not less than 30 feet (9144 mm) from tax-lot lines, including tax-lot lines adjacent to public ways.
